rows.grounds: compound nir+viṣa; adjective describing the resulting mantra powers
middle voice present of root jan
negative of cintyā; adjective agreeing with śaktayaḥ

items.question: How do mantra powers become poison-free and inconceivable for Śiva?
items.inference: The verse states that mantra powers become inconceivable and poison-free in relation to Śiva.
uncertainties: the exact syntactic role of nirviṣo remains slightly unclear
items.plain_english: O Śiva, the powers of mantras become inconceivable and poison-free.
